# KainFit

> Know what you ate. Instantly. A mobile-first food-logging app that turns plain-language meal descriptions into calories and macros.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of KainFit and how instant food logging works.
- [Try the demo](/demo): Explore KainFit with sample data — no account required.
- [Create account or sign in](/auth): Sign up or sign in to start logging meals.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): How KainFit handles your data.
- [Terms of service](/terms): Terms for using KainFit.
